scope: Adjacent integration discoveries in prefill/decode complete-output verification, copy workload parity, graph refresh, stream producer ordering and output signature; original 128 IDs unchanged.

discoveries.name: Partial decode payload and absent prefill validation
discoveries.before: All four old captures omit tail decode elements and every prefill element; old validate_result accepts injected corruption.
discoveries.fix: Preallocated flat full decode+prefill payload, actual prefill source input, full independent decode validation and exact prefill validation before capture.

discoveries.name: Prefill workload mismatch
discoveries.before: Baseline descriptor-pair prefill performs copy then add, giving 2*source, while its peer performs copy.
discoveries.fix: Baseline performs the same copy-only work. Historical timings remain unqualified.

discoveries.name: Stale FULL graph inputs
discoveries.before: FULL replay uses setup-captured graph q/k/v without refreshing from actual benchmark inputs.
discoveries.evidence_kind: source review; no pre-fix CUDA reproduction
discoveries.fix: Refresh graph q/k/v on decode stream before every FULL replay, within the measured region.

discoveries.name: Missing side-stream input production dependency
discoveries.before: Both optimized paths lack explicit caller-to-prefill/decode stream dependencies at benchmark entry.
discoveries.evidence_kind: source review; no pre-fix CUDA reproduction
discoveries.fix: Existing side streams wait for caller stream input writes; existing fan-in remains.

discoveries.name: Partial common output signature
discoveries.before: Common static signature still declares one sequence and eight tokens after peer outputs became complete.
discoveries.fix: Declare the complete batch, sequence and head-dimension output shape.

cuda_preflight.reason: Actual CUDA device required; CPU payload checks are not GPU qualification

prepared_cuda_gate.reference: Independent float64 dot-times-V cast to FP32 plus exact prefill source copy; fixed dyadic inputs only
prepared_cuda_gate.retention: Full actual outputs and references saved before validation; payloads, partial progress and failure traceback retained

independent_review.parent: Read five production files and new CPU/CUDA gate; source accepted with inherited tolerance limitation. No CUDA acceptance.
independent_review.hygiene_outcome: 552 passed, one Linux-only skip; five production source hashes match. CPU/source assertions only.

limitations: CPU payload fixtures intentionally bypass CUDA constructors/setup; no GPU mocks or benchmark-success simulation.
